description: This PHP source file defines the ClassHelper class within the OrangeHRM core helper namespace. The ClassHelper provides utility methods to check if a class exists, retrieve full class names with optional fallback namespaces, and verify if a class or object implements specific interfaces, aiding dynamic class and interface management within the application.

classes.name: ClassHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to verify class existence, retrieve class names with optional fallback namespaces, and check if classes implement specific interfaces.

methods.name: classExists
methods.description: Checks if a class with the given name exists, considering an optional fallback namespace.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the fully qualified class name, optionally using a fallback namespace if the class does not exist on its own.

methods.name: hasClassImplements
methods.description: Checks whether a given class or object implements all specified interfaces.
